_doc: Single source of truth for the data releases this database release shows. database.release is the release every page and the landing JSON-LD state (version); database.build_date is the JSON-LD dateModified. Read by website/data_versions.py: exposed to every template as `data_versions` and copied to <site>/data_versions.json. Search (search_index_v2.py meta.releases) and the report variant labels read from here. Edit this file, not the labels. `layers` says which source each part of the site uses; the batch entries are the inputs of the RRCS run.

rrcs_batch.label: GPCompaRe RRCS batch 2026-02-02
rrcs_batch.note: RRCS, dRRCS, CFR ranking and every structural number.

gpcrdb_models.label: GPCRdb models (2024-05-15 build): AlphaFold-Multistate, with plain AlphaFold2 for some states
gpcrdb_models.long_label: GPCRdb models (2024-05-15 build): AlphaFold-Multistate, with plain AlphaFold2 for 165 inactive and 26 active models
gpcrdb_models.methods: AlphaFold-Multistate, with plain AlphaFold2 for some states
gpcrdb_models.note: GPCRdb ran standard AlphaFold2 with all templates, classed the best model as active or inactive, and built the other state with AlphaFold-Multistate on state-filtered templates (Herrera et al., NAR 2025). The method of each model is GPCRdb's own label (model list read 2026-10-20), kept in data/model_methods.json; MCHR1 has none recorded.

gpcrdb_numbering.label: GPCRdb generic numbering
gpcrdb_numbering.note: Residue segments and generic numbers: GPCRdb API fetched 2026-10-18, with the batch annotation (GPCRdb, fetched 2026-02-02 to 2026-02-03) kept at the residues it covers; GPR3, GPR4 and XCR1 use the API numbering throughout. Snake-plot layouts come from the 2026 snapshot (data/snake_residues.json).

gnomad.label: gnomAD v4.1.2
gnomad.note: One transcript per gene (MANE Select or the transcript whose protein equals the model), positions mapped onto the model; exome counts where present, else genome. v4.1.2 variant data equal v4.1.1; neither changed allele counts or the variant set.

gnomad_batch.label: gnomAD v4.1.0
gnomad_batch.note: Variant query of the RRCS batch run, made before v4.1.1 (2026-03-30). Used by the AlphaMissense class comparison on the Statistics page.

alphamissense.label: AlphaMissense (Cheng et al. 2023)
alphamissense.note: One score per substitution from the Zenodo table (the same file as Zenodo 8208688).

conservation.label: VarSite conservation via ProtVar
conservation.note: ProtVar CONSERV per residue, cached 2026-04-22 (GPR3, GPR4 and XCR1 fetched 2026-10-18), placed on model residue numbering.

ensembl.label: Ensembl 116
ensembl.note: Search transcripts and coordinates. The gnomAD transcript of each gene was chosen from Ensembl on 2026-10-18.

refseq.label: NCBI RefSeq (Ensembl otherfeatures GRCh38; UCSC hg19.ncbiRefSeq 2024-09-18)
